items.title: Is Trane Technologies (TT) A Bargain As It Backs Clean Tech Training?
items.summary: Trane Technologies (TT) just tied its brand to workforce development in clean energy, committing a US$1 million grant over three years to expand Goodwill’s Clean Tech Accelerator training program. Recent trading has been choppy for Trane Technologies, with the share price at US$417.99 after falling 11.31% over the past 30 days and 12.96% over the past quarter. items.title: Trane Technologies (TT) Commits $1 Million To Clean Tech Workforce Training
items.summary: Trane Technologies (NYSE:TT) agreed to a three-year, US$1 million grant with Goodwill Industries to expand the Clean Tech Accelerator workforce program. The partnership aims to grow clean technology training capacity for skilled trades that support the clean energy economy. Goodwill Industries plans to use the funding to reach more participants through expanded training, career services, and employer connections. items.title: GCT Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong European Growth
items.summary: GigaCloud's Q3 2026 earnings and revenues beat estimates, fueled by European expansion, marketplace growth and stronger logistics services.

items.title: JPMorgan Global Select Equity (JGLO) Adds Broadcom and AMD on Nov. 10
items.summary: The fund bought $22.6 million of Broadcom and $22.0 million of AMD while selling $58.8 million of Nvidia.

items.title: Keeping AI Cool: AAON Rides the AI Heatwave to Record Growth
items.summary: AAON posted a Q3 earnings and revenue beat driven by surging BASX data center cooling sales, raised 2026 sales guidance, but also disclosed a material weakness requiring restated results.

items.title: AI Spending Will Slow. GE Vernova Stock Can Rise Anyway.

items.title: ZETA Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Shares Barely Move
items.summary: Zeta Global's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates as AI adoption, customer growth and higher platform usage fueled revenues, prompting a raised full-year outlook.

items.title: JPMorgan grows wary on AI-exposed industrials, lowers price targets
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan said it has become far more cautious on industrial stocks tied to AI data center spending, with the bank starting Eaton (NYSE:ETN), Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) and Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) at Neutral and lowering the price targets on most of its other AI-linked names.
